title: Cost law for a Goldreich–Levin stage
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a target function, let $\tau\in\mathbb Q$ satisfy $0<\tau\le1$, let $k<n$, and let the current state consist of an optional finite active family of coordinate subsets and a finite trace of estimate records. For any finite active family supplied to the stage, the law of the stage-step program is the image of the stage-estimate program's outcome law under the map that appends its estimate records to the state trace, updates the active family according to the Goldreich–Levin refinement rule, and adds controller work $16(n+1)^2(C+1)^2$ to the work cost, where $C=\lceil4/\tau^2\rceil$.
hypotheses_covered: target Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
natural-number stage index k with k < n
current state with optional active finite family and estimate trace
finite active family supplied to the stage
